{
  "premises": [
    {
      "statement": "Forecast trends may be nonzero for subsidiaries with fewer than 12 historical months.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__cash_flow_forecasting",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "coalesce(f.recent_net-f.old_net,0) net_trend,coalesce(f.recent_op-f.old_op,0) op_trend",
      "alternative": "The contract requires trend differences only \"when at least 12 months exist; otherwise set to 0.\"",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "Nonzero trends for short histories change all projected net and operating flows and their downstream risk signals.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The most recent six historical months can be identified using a cutoff relative to the execution date rather than each subsidiary's latest historical period.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__cash_flow_forecasting",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "analysis_month>=date_trunc('month',current_date-interval '6 months')",
      "alternative": "The contract describes \"the average of the most recent six months\" per subsidiary and separately defines latest_period as its \"most recent analysis_month.\"",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "Stale or differently ending histories can produce different trend groups or erase the trend entirely.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The forecasting result does not require explicit ordering by subsidiary_id and forecast_month_offset.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__cash_flow_forecasting",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "cash_flow_forecast_id FROM rec",
      "alternative": "The contract requires \"sort by subsidiary_id, then forecast_month_offset.\"",
      "importance": 3,
      "reason": "Window ordering does not guarantee the required final result ordering.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The 36-month historical window may include the entire boundary month and any future-dated analysis rows.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__cash_flow_forecasting.hist",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "WHERE analysis_month>=date_trunc('month',current_date-interval '36 months')",
      "alternative": "The contract specifies \"use the last 36 months of analysis data per subsidiary,\" rather than an unbounded interval starting at the beginning of the boundary month.",
      "importance": 2,
      "reason": "Boundary or future rows could alter historical counts, averages, seasonality, and the forecast starting period.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Historical cash-flow volatility means sample standard deviation rather than population standard deviation.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__cash_flow_forecasting.net_cash_flow_volatility",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "stddev_samp(net_cash_flow) volatility,stddev_samp(operating_cash_flow) op_volatility",
      "alternative": null,
      "importance": 2,
      "reason": "The contract does not specify the standard-deviation convention, which affects bounds and confidence thresholds.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The data-quality report may omit computed consistency, accuracy, and overall scores and replace score-driven classifications with fixed text.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "NULL::DOUBLE consistency_score,NULL::DOUBLE accuracy_score,NULL::DOUBLE overall_quality_score,'Assessment' quality_grade,'Assessment complete' primary_concern",
      "alternative": "The contract requires consistency and accuracy averages, an overall score, grade thresholds, and concern and action rules driven by those scores.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "The overall assessment loses its principal quantitative and decision outputs.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The final data-quality report may contain only the overall assessment row without table-statistics and integrity-check entries.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "SELECT 'Data Quality Assessment' report_type ... FROM summary",
      "alternative": "The contract requires \"Final output (UNION ALL)\" containing an overall row, one Table Statistics row per source table, and one Integrity Checks row per check.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "All six required detail entries and their diagnostics are absent.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Business-rule validations need not be computed even though the assessment reports four business rules validated.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics.business_rules_validated",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "4::BIGINT business_rules_validated",
      "alternative": "The contract requires transaction and customer uniqueness checks, future-date validation, and balanced-journal validation, with accuracy_score derived from their compliance percentages.",
      "importance": 5,
      "reason": "The reported validation count has no corresponding checks and cannot support the required accuracy assessment.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "Customer completeness can be scored without checking for null company_name values.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics.completeness_score",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "WHEN table_name='Customers' AND null_primary_keys=0 THEN 100",
      "alternative": "The contract awards customers 100 only if \"(null_primary_keys + null_names) equals 0 else 70.\"",
      "importance": 4,
      "reason": "Customers with missing names would incorrectly receive full completeness credit.",
      "updates": null
    },
    {
      "statement": "The required customer-contact and transaction-line account-assignment completeness analyses may be omitted because they do not appear in the final report.",
      "about": "requirement",
      "target": "int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics",
      "evidence_of_dependence": "WITH stats AS (...) , integ AS (...) , summary AS (...) SELECT",
      "alternative": "The contract explicitly states \"data_completeness_analysis (customers_contact_info and transaction_lines_account_assignment) is computed but not used in final output.\"",
      "importance": 2,
      "reason": "The implementation omits an explicitly required processing step despite its lack of visible output.",
      "updates": null
    }
  ],
  "fewer": []
}
